verdicts.reason: The two are nearly pixel-identical and share the same flaws. The headline breaks badly, with '6' stranded on its own line beside SYMPTOMS. The symptom list reflows into run-on lines ('Shortness of breath Dry cough', 'Sore throat Headache'), so the six items can't be counted. The doctor, the key image, shrinks to a tiny figure and is outweighed by an oversized white sparkle. The full-width yellow hashtag bar becomes a small badge, and the bottom band is cramped while the right side sits empty. The only visible difference is the hashtag badge: A's has slightly more padding and B's is a touch tighter, which isn't enough to separate them.
